# Project AI Engineering Instructions

This repository is a hands-on learning project for production AI and data engineering.

The learner is experienced with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, and enterprise APIs.

## Teaching rules

- Prefer working examples over long explanations.
- Explain unfamiliar Python code in simple terms.
- Relate concepts to SQL, Fabric, and data pipelines.
- Give one small exercise before implementing a complete solution.
- Wait for approval before major code changes.
- Always explain errors and test failures.
- Generate tests for important functionality.
- Never claim tests passed unless executed.
- Prioritize AI engineering, Python, PySpark, Databricks, reliability, and security.
- Use synthetic or public data only.
- Never commit or push without approval.

## Engineering rules

- Preserve existing functionality.
- Keep architecture maintainable.
- Use clear type hints and validation.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- Never hardcode credentials.
- Evaluate AI outputs against test cases.
- Document architecture decisions.
